title: ceramia helianthemifolia
intro: Ceramia helianthemifolia, commonly known as the Red Ceylon Coral, is a species of coral-like flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ceramia helianthemifolia include its use as an antipyretic to reduce fever, an analgesic to alleviate pain, and an antibacterial agent to fight infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for the plant's medicinal properties include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
